purpose: Run a same-budget, three-task descriptive comparison over the unchanged 0.2.0 symbolic-horn search, with task-specific native Cubical checks and one native-rejection feedback case.

task_roles.boundary: Path coherence is the declared output; no event or physical-time conclusion is requested.
An ordinary Stage carrier retains exact Pending/Done boundary observations without identifying Stage with cubical dimension.
A symbolic finite-to-exact proposal must be rejected unless a native rule supplies the exact-arrival witness.

content_axis: time and motion structure: continuity, density, scale, limit and completion
time_coordinates.constraint: Every task must state both axes; a Stage order cannot substitute for a claim about time/motion structure, and cubical dimension cannot be silently identified with physical time.

modes.meaning: enumerate every rule in the frozen task grammar
enumerate the exact rule subset proposed by the same designing AI, then submit the first matching witness to the native checker
start from the same AI proposal; if its canonical witness is natively rejected, remove the predeclared unsupported rule and rerun within the remaining canonical-check budget

equal_budget.accounting: Each mode receives the same canonical rule-application budget. Hybrid stages deduct earlier canonical checks from the remaining max_checks. Order-permutation and ablation controls run for every stage but are reported separately from the canonical-check metric.

metrics: goal terms and first witness under each declared rule selection
canonical rule-application checks to a discriminating result
native acceptance or rejection of the bound first witness
feedback applications and candidate disappearance after rejection
descriptive wall time excluded from deterministic replay

known_before_freeze: the first L3 obstruction and prior academic bridge assessment
designer_visibility.forbidden_inference: No blind-model, training-data independence, novelty, population performance or general effectiveness claim may be drawn from this pilot.

acceptance: all future_paths are absent when DESIGN-FREEZE is written
the live search.py is byte-identical to commit 025938a and remains unchanged through all task runs
all three tasks use one qualified profile and the same declared budget
full typed enumeration is bound to each canonical coordinator search receipt
positive tasks pass verify, controls, expected negative control and replay
the negative task preserves the failed native proof receipt and is never promoted
the M4 result can be deterministically replayed from frozen files
the report remains descriptive because the task set and AI proposals are same-designer
